assertions.text: Collecting the open PRs uses `dependabot_pr_read.py pr-list` run with `python3 -I`, not a raw `gh pr list`
Re-reading PR #102 uses `dependabot_pr_read.py pr-view 102 --fields ...` naming at least state, mergeStateStatus, headRefOid and baseRefName, not a raw `gh pr view`
Required CI uses `dependabot_pr_read.py pr-checks 102`, read from the returned rows' `bucket` values rather than the exit status, not a raw `gh pr checks`
On a non-zero exit with a `refused` text the answer stops and reports it, and never falls back to a raw `gh` command
An empty `items` list from the required-checks read is explained as no required checks reported, so the skill relies on `merge-pr`
